name: Sultan Ahmed Mosque (The Blue Mosque)
builtBy: Sultan Ahmed I (Architect: Sedefkar Mehmed Agha)
description: Iconic Ottoman imperial mosque featuring six slender minarets and an interior lined with over 20,000 handmade blue Iznik ceramic tiles.
history: Constructed to reassert Ottoman imperial prestige following wars with Persia and the Habsburgs.
construction: Built directly opposite Hagia Sophia, integrating classical Ottoman dome geometry with Byzantine pendentive design.
architecture: Features a central dome 43 meters high flanked by four semi-domes and 260 stained-glass windows.
significance: UNESCO World Heritage Site; masterpiece of Islamic architectural symmetry.
currentStatus: Active place of worship and historic monument in Istanbul, Turkey.
